title: Fleet scorecard
description: Is the fleet beating a pro team: merged per day, run failure share and idle runner minutes, 14 days.

options.content:
Fleet-ops#10711. The one number this dashboard can compute today is **idle agent-runner minutes while ready work waits**, at the bottom: runner-minutes with no agent run in flight, on days when an open `agent-ready` issue was waiting, against that day's mean count of online agent runners.

The two tables above bucket days with SUBSTRING, which the expression engine allows, and the merged table searches each repository on its own (Fleet-ops#10853). The failed share counts every non-success finished run, not only infra failures.

No data source yet (follow-up issue): pushed head to review verdict, approval to merge, Claude limit per merged PR. Targets: idle 0 min/day, verdict p50 < 20 min and p90 < 60 min, infra failures < 2%, approval to merge < 15 min, products ahead of fleet-ops, Claude limit per PR cut 30%.

panels.title: Merged per day, products versus fleet-ops, last 14 days
panels.description: Target: products ahead of fleet-ops. Alert: scorecard-products-behind.

targets.expression:
SELECT d AS day, SUM(CASE WHEN plane = 'products' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS products, SUM(CASE WHEN plane = 'fleet-ops' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fleet_ops
FROM (SELECT SUBSTRING(closed_at, 1, 10) AS d, 'fleet-ops' AS plane FROM A UNION ALL SELECT SUBSTRING(closed_at, 1, 10), 'products' FROM B UNION ALL SELECT SUBSTRING(closed_at, 1, 10), 'products' FROM C UNION ALL SELECT SUBSTRING(closed_at, 1, 10), 'products' FROM D UNION ALL SELECT SUBSTRING(closed_at, 1, 10), 'products' FROM E UNION ALL SELECT SUBSTRING(closed_at, 1, 10), 'products' FROM F UNION ALL SELECT SUBSTRING(closed_at, 1, 10), 'products' FROM G UNION ALL SELECT SUBSTRING(closed_at, 1, 10), 'products' FROM H UNION ALL SELECT SUBSTRING(closed_at, 1, 10), 'products' FROM I) AS merged
GROUP BY d ORDER BY d

panels.title: Failed share of agent runs per day, last 14 days
panels.description: agent.yml and agent-dispatch.yml in fleet-ops, finished runs. Target: under 2%. Alert: scorecard-run-failure-share.

targets.expression:
SELECT d AS day, COUNT(*) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN conclusion = 'success' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS failed,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN conclusion = 'success' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS failed_percent
FROM (SELECT SUBSTRING(created_at, 1, 10) AS d, conclusion FROM A UNION ALL SELECT SUBSTRING(created_at, 1, 10), conclusion FROM B) AS runs
WHERE conclusion IN ('success', 'failure', 'timed_out', 'startup_failure')
GROUP BY d ORDER BY d

panels.title: Idle agent-runner minutes while ready work waits, per day, last 14 days
panels.description: Target: 0. Runner-minutes on the agent pool with no agent run in flight, on days when an open agent-ready issue was waiting that is not blocked, parked or waiting on a decision. The runner count is the day's mean over online runners. A run's minutes are its own span, booked on the day it started and counted to now while it still runs. Days are UTC. The issue search reads 30 days of issues updated in that window and reads today's labels, so a long-silent wait falls outside it. An empty table means the runner metric is missing.

targets.expression:
WITH days AS (
  SELECT FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP() / 86400) * 86400 - 86400 * n AS day_start,
         CASE WHEN n = 0 THEN (UNIX_TIMESTAMP() - FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP() / 86400) * 86400) / 60.0 ELSE 1440 END AS minutes
  FROM (SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 4 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 5 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 6 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 7 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 8 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 9 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 10 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 11 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 12 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 13 AS n) AS spine
), inflight AS (
  SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(run_started_at) AS started,
         CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN UNIX_TIMESTAMP(updated_at) ELSE UNIX_TIMESTAMP() END AS ended
  FROM A
  WHERE run_started_at IS NOT NULL
), busy AS (
  SELECT FLOOR(started / 86400) AS day_index, SUM(CASE WHEN ended > started THEN ended - started ELSE 0 END) / 60.0 AS busy_minutes
  FROM inflight
  GROUP BY FLOOR(started / 86400)
), slots AS (
  SELECT FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(time) / 86400) AS day_index, AVG(__value__) AS slots FROM P GROUP BY FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(time) / 86400)
), pool AS (SELECT AVG(__value__) AS slots FROM P), waiting AS (
  SELECT d.day_start AS day_start, COUNT(*) AS ready_issues
  FROM days d JOIN B ON UNIX_TIMESTAMP(B.created_at) < d.day_start + 86400 AND COALESCE(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(B.closed_at), UNIX_TIMESTAMP()) >= d.day_start
  GROUP BY d.day_start
)
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(d.day_start), '%Y-%m-%d') AS day,
       COALESCE(w.ready_issues, 0) AS ready_issues,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(w.ready_issues, 0) = 0 THEN 0
            WHEN COALESCE(sl.slots, pool.slots) * d.minutes - COALESCE(bs.busy_minutes, 0) < 0 THEN 0
            ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(sl.slots, pool.slots) * d.minutes - COALESCE(bs.busy_minutes, 0), 0) END AS idle_minutes
FROM days d
CROSS JOIN pool
LEFT JOIN busy bs ON bs.day_index = FLOOR(d.day_start / 86400)
LEFT JOIN slots sl ON sl.day_index = FLOOR(d.day_start / 86400)
LEFT JOIN waiting w ON w.day_start = d.day_start
ORDER BY d.day_start
